name: Series B SaaS
description: For SaaS companies at Series B stage with 30-80 people. Formal departments with dedicated heads, VP-level leadership, and the first COO or Chief of Staff hire. Product-market fit is proven and the focus shifts to scalable growth, team specialization, and operational discipline.

org_structure.overview: At Series B the company organizes into full departments led by VP-level leaders. The philosophy is 'scalable accountability' — each department owns its metrics and operating plan. Engineering scales into multiple teams with dedicated EMs. Design becomes a distinct function. Customer Success formalizes as a revenue-critical department separate from Support. The CEO adds a COO or Chief of Staff to manage operations, allowing the CEO to focus on strategy, board relations, and fundraising. Processes for planning, reviews, and cross-functional coordination become institutionalized.

departments.name: Engineering
departments.description: Multiple teams organized by product area or platform. Dedicated infrastructure/DevOps role. Established on-call, incident response, and release engineering practices.

roles.title: VP of Engineering
roles.description: Sets engineering strategy, grows the organization, and ensures delivery against the product roadmap. Manages multiple Engineering Managers. Owns engineering budget and tooling decisions.

roles.title: Engineering Manager
roles.description: Leads a team of 4-6 engineers in a specific area (e.g., backend, frontend, platform, data). Conducts sprint planning, 1:1s, and career development.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.description: Leads technical design for major initiatives. Mentors junior team members and drives code quality standards.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Delivers features and improvements across the codebase. Participates in on-call rotation.

roles.title: DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
roles.description: Owns cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and incident response. Ensures uptime and scalability.

departments.name: Product
departments.description: Multiple PMs each owning a product area. Establishes data-informed product practices including experimentation and user research.

roles.title: VP of Product
roles.description: Owns product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the entire platform. Manages Product Directors/Managers and partners with Engineering and Design leadership.

roles.title: Director of Product
roles.description: Owns product strategy for a major area (e.g., core product, growth, platform). Manages a team of PMs.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.description: Defines features, writes specs, manages backlog, runs A/B tests, and coordinates with engineering and design.

departments.name: Design
departments.description: Establishes design systems, user research, and visual brand standards. Partners with Product and Engineering on every initiative.

roles.title: Design Lead / Director of Design
roles.description: Establishes design vision, design system, and user research practice. Manages the design team and ensures brand consistency.

roles.title: Product Designer
roles.description: Creates wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Conducts user testing and iterates on feedback.

departments.name: Marketing
departments.description: Multi-channel demand generation with dedicated content, product marketing, and brand functions. Supports pipeline generation and revenue targets.

roles.title: VP of Marketing
roles.description: Owns brand, demand generation, content, product marketing, and communications. Drives marketing OKRs and budget.

roles.title: Director of Demand Generation
roles.description: Owns paid acquisition, SEO, events, and inbound funnel. Optimizes conversion from lead to MQL to SQL.

roles.title: Product Marketing Manager
roles.description: Owns positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market launches.

roles.title: Content Marketing Manager
roles.description: Creates blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, and social content to drive organic reach.

roles.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
roles.description: Manages marketing tech stack (HubSpot/Marketo), attribution, reporting, and campaign analytics.

departments.name: Sales
departments.description: Scaled sales organization with multiple AEs and first SDRs. Defined sales methodology, territories, and compensation plans.

roles.title: VP of Sales
roles.description: Owns revenue targets, sales strategy, team hiring, and forecasting. Manages directors and carries overall quota responsibility.

roles.title: Director of Sales
roles.description: Manages a pod of AEs. Coaches on deals, runs forecast reviews, and helps close strategic opportunities.

roles.title: Account Executive
roles.description: Runs full-cycle sales. Manages pipeline, delivers demos, negotiates, and closes.

roles.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
roles.description: Prospects and qualifies inbound leads to create pipeline for AEs. First human touchpoint for many prospects.

departments.name: Customer Success
departments.description: Drives adoption, retention, and expansion across the customer base. Separate from Support, focused on outcomes and renewals.

roles.title: VP of Customer Success
roles.description: Owns customer health, NRR, churn, and expansion revenue. Builds the CS playbook and team.

roles.title: Customer Success Manager
roles.description: Manages a portfolio of customer accounts. Drives onboarding, adoption, QBRs, and renewal conversations.

roles.title: Customer Support Lead
roles.description: Manages support ticketing, SLAs, and support team. Ensures timely resolution and customer satisfaction.

roles.title: Customer Support Specialist
roles.description: Responds to support tickets, troubleshoots issues, and escalates to engineering when needed.

departments.name: People / HR
departments.description: Establishes HR infrastructure: performance reviews, compensation bands, benefits, compliance, and culture programs.

roles.title: Head of People
roles.description: Builds people strategy, manages recruiting pipeline, establishes performance management, and shapes company culture.

roles.title: People Operations Generalist
roles.description: Handles payroll, benefits administration, onboarding, offboarding, and employee relations.

key_relationships: VP Product, VP Engineering, and Design Lead form the 'product triad' that jointly owns feature delivery from concept to shipped.
VP Marketing and VP Sales meet weekly on funnel metrics and hold a joint quarterly planning session.
Customer Success feeds product feedback directly into Product's roadmap prioritization.
COO (if hired) runs the weekly leadership team meeting and owns cross-functional planning and OKR tracking.
Head of People partners with all VPs on hiring plans, retention, and organizational design.
Engineering Managers and Product Managers pair up per squad — no PM is assigned without a corresponding EM.
